Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Material Grade: IRS Grade A Steel Plate, fully compliant with the Indi a Register of Shipping (IRS) Rules for Hull Structural Steel. 2. Test Certificates: A Joint Test Report and Mill Test Certificate (MTC) are requi re, both certified in accordance with IRS Class Rules. 3. All plates shall be new, free from any rust, scales, pittings, and mechanical damage. 4. Plate Markings: Each plate must be clearly marked with the manufacturer's name, mill serial number, heat/cast number, material grade, dimensions, an d weight, /OPTIONAL: include the customer's name: CSL and PO Number 5. Stamping & Identification: The Material Grade and Heat Number must be ha rd-punched and highlighted with a highly visible paint colour for easy identifi cation. 6. Class Approval Documentation: The original IRS-approved MTC must be pro vided at the time of delivery. 7. Approved Manufacturers: Plates must be sourced from reputed indigenous manufacturers only (e.g., SAIL, AMNSI (ESSAR), Jindal Steel, or Tata Steel). C SL accepts indigenous makes exclusively; imported plates will be rejected.

8. Plate Quality & Uniformity: All plates shall be of uniform length and width, fr ee from laminations, surface irregularities, or any defects as defined by IRS r ules. 9. Vendor Scope: The vendor is responsible for mill loading, transportation to t he site, unloading, and all associated sundry expenses. 10. Mill Certification: The manufacturing mill must be approved by IRS 11. Plates should be supplied within 30 days from date of GeM Contract. CSL re serves the full rights to reject any offer with non-feasible delivery period. 12. All plates should be as per the size mentioned in the tender 13. The maximum amount payable for each sizes shall be as per GEM contract only. 14. Equivalent Grades are not acceptable 15.
